notes.title: TERMINAL ESC v1.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982162/b000e47051868ea27eea18cd762f7b55af535107.png[/img]
At PRAET, we pride ourselves on being at the cutting edge of innovation. When you download a new version of our software, rest assured you’ll discover exciting new features, superior optimization, and of course enhanced monetization strategies.

Sometimes, staying ahead of the curve means introducing breaking changes. To those who find your command logs no longer executing as expected - we hear you. We understand how it feels when our pursuit of market dominance impacts your livelihood* and we deeply appreciate your sacrifice.

And remember, it’s all thanks to YOU and YOUR invaluable participation that we’ve identified so many areas for improvement. If anyone deserves credit for these enhancements, it’s you. THANK YOU.

For those affected, here are a few tips:
[list]
[*] Changes should not affect saved games in progress. However you may have to amend certain strategies upon resuming your game.
[*] Multi-line sections of a command log can be pasted directly into the terminal. If a command log is failing to execute on import, you can minimize lost work by pasting the portions that execute correctly and proceeding from there.
[*] A complete change log can be viewed by pressing 'r' in the main menu.
[/list]

*[i]Applicants whose visas are contingent upon successful completion will not be eligible for compensation in the event that update-related issues impact their results.[/i]
